segments.title: 第62章 經典送水
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years, Chapter 62: The Classic Water Delivery

Around four in the afternoon, the buses drove into the gates of a military camp in the northeastern part of Yinjiang District in an orderly fashion.

Li Luo returned the retuned guitar to Lin Yuan. When he got back to his seat, Yan Zhusheng, who was beside him, was still staring at him with a very strange expression.

"Ahem... what's wrong?" Li Luo felt a little unnerved by her stare, wondering if he had overdone it.

"Unless one has practiced since childhood, it's very difficult for an ordinary person to accurately identify musical pitch," Yan Zhusheng said with a serious face. "Especially without a reference tone."

But Li Luo had gone from someone who couldn't recognize pitch at all to the level of perfect pitch in just over twenty minutes.

This gave Yan Zhusheng a rare inner shock. She had never seen or heard of such a thing happening before.

"...Maybe I just have a good memory." Li Luo didn't quite understand the significance of perfect pitch.

He had simply designated a room in his memory palace specifically for memorizing those pitches.

When he needed to identify a pitch Yan Zhusheng played, he would just compare it to the ones in his memory palace and find the match.

It was equivalent to directly downloading a bunch of reference tones into his brain, a secret cheat to achieve a state of pseudo-perfect pitch.

However, he was still quite clumsy with it and could only identify single notes.

If Yan Zhusheng played a series of notes, Li Luo would probably be flustered for a while and need some time to distinguish them.

This would require more practice.

"Okay, we've arrived." Kong Junxiang stood up at this moment, clapping his hands to get everyone's attention. "After you get off the bus, follow Drill Instructor Zhang. We'll go to the dormitory building to drop off our luggage first."

Drill Instructor Zhang got off the bus and led the students of Class 8 toward the dormitory building.

The military camp had arranged two buildings, one for boys and one for girls.

Li Luo walked into their dorm room. It was an eight-person room with bunk beds.

Zhu Yufei followed him in, and behind him were Lin Yuan, Zhang Guohuang, Wei Chun, Fang Chen, and others.

Shao Heqi did not come in; he had slipped away to the dorm next door, not planning to stay in the same room as Li Luo.

After settling their luggage, everyone gathered in the hallway to look at the scenery.

During this time, Drill Instructor Zhang came by and personally demonstrated how to fold a quilt into a "tofu block."

Li Luo invited the instructor to use his quilt for the demonstration. After Drill Instructor Zhang finished and left, he immediately put the tofu block quilt in a corner and took out a thin blanket from his suitcase to use for sleeping.

"Class President, what's the meaning of this?"

"Can't you tell?" Li Luo raised his eyebrows. "This tofu block has to be folded every morning after waking up, and it'll be inspected. So, I might as well have the instructor fold it for me."

"I'll use a blanket to sleep, and in the morning, I'll just stuff it into my suitcase. It saves me the trouble of folding a tofu block."

Hearing Li Luo's explanation, the others immediately exclaimed, "Damn," thinking that the Class President was a true freaking genius.

At half-past five in the evening, the whistle for assembly sounded from downstairs.

Everyone hurried downstairs, lined up, and under the leadership of their respective class instructors, marched majestically toward the cafeteria.

Along the way, the drill instructor briefly introduced the military training grounds, pointing out which areas were accessible and which were off-limits.

After a unified dinner, tonight was free time. The formal military training would begin tomorrow morning.

The training grounds happened to have a basketball court, so Li Luo borrowed a basketball from Drill Instructor Zhang and led the boys from his class to play.

...

"Xixi, Xie Shuchen and the others said they're going over there to play basketball." Qiao Xinyan ran back to the dorm and said to Ying Chanxi, who was sitting on her bed reading a book. "Should we go for a walk too?"

"No." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "There's the start-of-term exam right after the military training ends. I have to find time to review."

"You still need to review with your grades? How are the rest of us supposed to live?" Qiao Xinyan looked exasperated, then her eyes darted around, and she added, "It seems like Li Luo and the others from Class 8 are playing ball too. Are you sure you're not going?"

"Li Luo is there too?" Ying Chanxi raised her eyebrows, silently put down the book in her hand, got up, and walked out of the dorm. She stood in the hallway and gazed toward the distant outdoor basketball court.

But everyone was wearing military training uniforms, a sea of green, so it was impossible to tell who was who.

"Oh, come on, who cares if he's there or not? We'll definitely find him if we just go for a walk." Qiao Xinyan grabbed Ying Chanxi's hand and headed downstairs.

Ying Chanxi was helpless against her, so she had to accompany her downstairs for a walk toward the basketball court.

By now, the sky was growing dark, and bright incandescent lights illuminated the area around the basketball court.

Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan walked along the path and arrived at the edge of the court, where they saw the boys from Class 1 gathered under one of the hoops, playing.

However, Ying Chanxi didn't spare them more than a few glances. After a quick scan, her gaze fell upon another hoop not far away, where she spotted Li Luo's figure.

Although Ying Chanxi paid no attention to the boys from her own class, as soon as she arrived, the boys from Class 1 were instantly fired up.

Whether the shot went in or not was unknown, but their moves had to be slick, and their posture had to be cool.

For this reason, Liu Shaowen and Xie Shuchen even started clashing on the court. It was clearly a casual game, yet they played with great ferocity.

But Ying Chanxi's gaze never rested on them at all.

"I'm going to the tuck shop," Ying Chanxi said to Qiao Xinyan, turning around after confirming Li Luo was there.

Qiao Xinyan followed behind, asking with a grin, "Xixi, do you want to buy an extra bottle of water? Then you can see which guy plays the best and give it to him. You'll definitely make all the guys on the court go wild."

"I'm not that childish." Ying Chanxi glanced at Qiao Xinyan, shook her head, and then took two bottles of cold water from the tuck shop's cooler.

"Then why are you getting two bottles?" Qiao Xinyan asked, puzzled.

"One... one is for Li Luo."

"...You're way too nice to your cousin."

After paying, Ying Chanxi hurried toward the basketball court, carrying a bottle in each hand, which instantly attracted the gazes of many boys.

Many of them had already been watching Ying Chanxi's movements, and when they saw the two bottles of water in her hands, they all got excited.

This was especially true for Xie Shuchen and Liu Shaowen. Upon seeing this, they clashed even more intensely on the court, like a pair of rutting bulls locking horns in an arena.

But under all these gazes, Ying Chanxi walked toward the court where Li Luo and Class 8 were playing.

What Ying Chanxi didn't expect, however, was that before she even got there, the figure of another girl had already arrived at the edge of Li Luo's basketball court, waving at him.

Li Luo walked over curiously, only to see the girl with long, flowing hair hand over a drink with a bright smile.

The surrounding boys immediately erupted in whoops and catcalls.

After giving the drink, the girl ran off with a faint blush on her cheeks.

"Class President, you're amazing," Zhu Yufei sidled over and said with a chuckle. "You've already got a girl giving you a drink."

"What did you guys just talk about?" Lin Yuan also asked curiously.

"She said she really liked the song I sang." Li Luo had a strange expression as he looked down at the drink in his hand.

"Damn, then why didn't she give one to me? I sang yesterday too," Lin Yuan grumbled indignantly.

"You really think she gave it to him just for the singing?" Zhu Yufei chuckled twice, then asked, "So who was that girl?"

"She didn't say, but she should be Gao Yuqin from Class 7," Li Luo said casually. "The class president from the class next door, I think. I saw her at a meeting before."

"Oh, your memory is pretty good then."

"Of course it is..." Li Luo replied subconsciously, then suddenly realized the voice sounded a bit familiar. He turned his head and saw Ying Chanxi standing behind him, looking at him with a wide smile.
